items.headline: $IRYS Explodes 1,200% Past Its May Listing Peak
items.summary: $IRYS has surged 1,200% past its May listing high, implying a ~$561M circulating valuation with only 20% of supply in circulation. Low float could keep volatility extreme.

items.headline: $INIT Network Halted After Attacker Mints Tokens
items.summary: Initia froze its network after a security incident in which an attacker reportedly minted tokens, with onchain data showing a $2.7M ETH transfer. $INIT holders await the scope of the exploit.

items.headline: Kalshi Prediction Markets Go Live in Phantom Wallet
items.summary: Phantom rolled out Kalshi prediction markets to US users, funded with CASH stablecoins, despite ongoing state lawsuits. A big mainstream onramp for onchain prediction trading.

items.headline: Lighter Adds $weETH as Perps Collateral
items.summary: Perp DEX Lighter now accepts $weETH as margin, counting 70% of its index value with a 1,000 weETH platform cap. Another DeFi use case for liquid restaking tokens.

items.headline: Kraken Keeps $XMR, Scraps Withdrawal Questionnaires
items.summary: Kraken dropped its Monero withdrawal questionnaires while keeping $XMR listed, with co-CEO Arjun Sethi calling questions about clients' coin usage unacceptable. A rare win for privacy coins.
